title: Mask secrets and tokens
role: Developers sharing code, logs, or terminal snippets with AI models
saves: Accidentally leaking production API keys, Bearer tokens, or database passwords to external LLMs
summary: Type =mask-secrets and paste text, curl commands, or logs. Redacts OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, Stripe, and database credentials locally before you forward them.

tests.name: redacts live authorization bearer token from copied curl command
redacts OpenAI project key and AWS access key from env dump
redacts database credentials without breaking hostname or port
preserves ordinary developer code and variable names without false positives
